title: Ice Mage and Demon
description: A blue-skinned demonic male with large curved horns, long braided hair and red tattered clothing stands beside an elegant elf-like female mage with long white hair wearing a glowing teal and silver ice-themed dress. To their right is a fully bandaged mummy holding a lit lantern. They stand before a stone archway covered in glowing blue crystals and purple magical energy.
